ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated on the peripheral border and discrete punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes. Low-intensity black border along the trailing edge. Discrete black circular blobs scattered throughout the white field. Central vertical low-intensity band at the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees; depth is approximately 10% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys occurring every 20-40 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; initial convexity from the median notch transitioning to a slight concavity before ending in a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense cluster of circular low-contrast grey and high-contrast black punctate marks distributed primarily in the upper half of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a dark, vertically oriented pigmentation/scar feature at the median base. Calcified barnacle clusters visible on the extreme lateral tips.
